name: Related news tab or section is visible on a match detail page
description: A match detail page should have a visible Related News tab, section header, or control enabling navigation to recent news about the match.

planSteps.description: Click on any bracket match cell to open a match detail page
Wait for the match detail page to load
Verify that a tab, button, or section labeled 'News', 'Related News', 'Latest News', or similar is visible on the match detail page without needing to scroll far
